title: Finite radicial realization of a generic purely inseparable residue-field extension
statement: Let $S$ be a reduced affine scheme [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-pbc-scheme-reduction], $\eta$ a generic point of an irreducible component of $S$ [def-weil-irreducible-components] [def-sc-generic-point], and $K/\kappa(\eta)$ a specified finite purely inseparable field extension [def-weil-pbc-finite-purely-inseparable-extension]. There are an affine open neighbourhood $U\subset S$ of $\eta$, a reduced affine scheme $V$, and a finite surjective universally injective morphism $g:V\to U$ [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] [def-weil-radicial-morphism]. There is a generic point $\eta_V$ of an irreducible component of $V$ mapping to $\eta$ under $q=g\circ(U\hookrightarrow S)$, and a ring isomorphism $e:\kappa(\eta_V)\simeq K$ such that the composite $\kappa(\eta)\xrightarrow{q^\#}\kappa(\eta_V)\xrightarrow{e}K$ is exactly the specified field embedding. The map $q^\#$ here includes the residue-field identification induced by the equality $q(\eta_V)=\eta$.

proof.text: The local ring at a minimal prime of a reduced affine ring is a field, equal to its residue field. This identifies the coefficients to be cleared before each root adjunction.

Realize $k'/k$ on a finite radicial base cover, using a finite tower of degree-$p$ extensions: induct on $[k'/k]$, apply the intermediate-field lemma to write $k'=M(z)$ with $[k':M]=p$, construct the tower for the smaller extension $M/k$, and append $M(z)/M$; in characteristic zero the tower is empty. At a stage with reduced affine base $\operatorname{Spec}B$ and generic residue field $l$, first shrink to make $p=0$ in $B$, since $p=0$ in $B_{\mathfrak q}=l$. For the next generator $\beta$ with $\beta^p=a\in l$, shrink again to represent $a$ in $B$, and put $C=B[t]/(t^p-a)$. This is finite free on $1,t,\ldots,t^{p-1}$. Every field-valued point lifts after adjoining a root of $t^p-a$, and two roots in any field are equal because $(u-v)^p=0$. Thus $\operatorname{Spec}C\to\operatorname{Spec}B$ is surjective and universally injective by the field-point criterion. At $\mathfrak q$, $C\otimes_B l=l(\beta)$, a field, so the unique point above $\mathfrak q$ has that local ring. Reducing $C$ preserves this local field and gives another finite radicial surjection. Induct on the tower length; its terminal residue field is $k'$. The finite, surjective and universally injective assertions for each root quotient are supplied by the proved root-cover lemma.

All shrinkings on an intermediate finite radicial cover can be effected by shrinking the original base: if $h:Z\to U$ is that cover and $O\subset Z$ contains the unique point over $\eta$, remove the closed set $h(Z\setminus O)$ from $U$. Choose a principal open neighbourhood of $\eta$ inside that remaining open of the original affine base. Its inverse image is contained in $O$ and is affine by finiteness of $h$. Thus both the original base and its finite cover remain affine at each stage. Finiteness and closedness of $h$ justify this operation without a Noetherian assumption. Finite composition and base change preserve finiteness; the pointwise injectivity after every base change and surjectivity persist under composition. We now have a reduced affine base $V$ finite, surjective, universally injective over an open $U$ of the original $S$, whose generic residue field is $k'$. Any later shrinking of $V$ is handled in the same way, restricting all the diagram objects by base change. For readability call this reduced affine base $\operatorname{Spec}A$ and its generic field $k$. The proved affine shrinking lemma implements the closed-complement operation.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finite_radicial_generic_residue_extension
    {S : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine S] [IsReduced S]
    (η : S) (hη : ∃ Z ∈ irreducibleComponents S, IsGenericPoint η Z)
    (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra (S.residueField η) K]
    [Module.Finite (S.residueField η) K] [IsPurelyInseparable (S.residueField η) K] :
    ∃ (U : S.Opens) (_ : η ∈ U) (V : Scheme.{u}) (g : V ⟶ U.toScheme),
      IsAffine U.toScheme ∧ IsAffine V ∧ IsReduced V ∧
      IsFinite g ∧ Surjective g ∧ UniversallyInjective g ∧
      ∃ (ηV : V) (hq : (g ≫ U.ι) ηV = η),
        (∃ Z ∈ irreducibleComponents V, IsGenericPoint ηV Z) ∧
        ∃ e : V.residueField ηV ≃+* K,
          e.toRingHom.comp
            (((S.residueFieldCongr hq).inv ≫ (g ≫ U.ι).residueFieldMap ηV).hom) =
              algebraMap (S.residueField η) K
